noticias.titulo: CrowdStrike-Zscaler Merger Could Make Cybersecurity Rival ‘More Formidable’ Against Palo Alto Networks, Says Jefferies
noticias.resumo:
# CrowdStrike-Zscaler Merger Could Make Cybersecurity Rival ‘More Formidable’ Against Palo Alto Networks, Says Jefferies

- Jefferies said a potential acquisition of Zscaler would help CrowdStrike expand its presence in network security while strengthening its visibility into network activity in the age of AI. 
- The firm believes that the combination would make CrowdStrike a more formidable competitor to Palo Alto Networks across several product categories. 
- Jefferies sees a "better than a coin flip likelihood" of a deal materializing at $255 or more per Zscaler share, with the firm describing that price as a "reasonable" takeout valuation.
